AI Boom Drives Up Housing Prices in San Francisco

A report by Compass found that rapid growth in AI technology has led to overbidding in San Francisco's housing market, with buyers spending significantly more than sellers are asking for. This trend is driven by the increasing wealth generated by the city's thriving tech industry. As a result, the median home price in San Francisco has reached a record high.
